info.name: CW eAdaptor Next - Model Integration
info.description: Builds up from reachability to a real message submission, modeled against H56_TRN_CW2SAGE (a known-working UAT integration - see docs/discovery/uat-integration-verification-summary.md). Use with the eadaptor-next-environment.json environment. Password is stored as a Postman 'secret' variable type - never commit a populated environment file with real credentials.

request.description: Confirms the host is reachable and serving the eAdaptor app. Expect 200 (landing page) - NOT the submission endpoint itself, so a real message here isn't expected to succeed.

exec: pm.test('Host is reachable (2xx or 405, not a connection error)', function () {

request.description: Empty body, real credentials. Expected results, per docs/backlog/eadaptor-inbound-auth-401.md: 401 = credential/config problem (wrong endpoint or bad password). 400 = auth succeeded, body content rejected (this is the 'good' result for an empty-body test - it means the credential works).

exec: pm.test('Auth succeeded (400 = passed auth, failed on empty body - the expected good result here)', function () {
pm.test('NOT 401 - if this fails, check docs/backlog/eadaptor-inbound-auth-401.md before assuming a new bug', function () {
